verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is API-first. Its docs say documents, embeddings, full-text, semantic and conversational search are all exposed 'from a single API', authenticated with API keys, with dedicated endpoints such as facet search and a native MCP server at POST /mcp. Typed official SDKs exist for about 10 languages, llms.txt and markdown docs are served for AI agents, and community users report driving it programmatically (bulk-loading 1M records, multi-index search from a frontend). Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found (all probed paths returned 404), and the pack has little detailed API-reference evidence beyond individual endpoints.
